THE PRODUCT
The Trade is the central record
textPreview: The Trade is the central record

text: The module derives it from the Odoo documents the team already uses.
textPreview: The module derives it from the Odoo documents the team already uses.

text: Purchase orders
A confirmed purchase opens or updates a long trade.
textPreview: A confirmed purchase opens or updates a long trade.

text: Sale orders
A confirmed sale links to an open trade. If none exists, it can open a short trade.
textPreview: A confirmed sale links to an open trade. If none exists, it can open a short trade.

text: Bills and stock
Linked invoices affect extra cost or revenue. Validated receipts link stock lots.
textPreview: Linked invoices affect extra cost or revenue. Validated receipts link stock lots.

text: The result: one connected ledger for the commercial position and its financial outcome.
textPreview: The result: one connected ledger for the commercial position and its financial outcome.

text: Source: ele_trading README, sections 1, 3 and 4. “Ledger” is descriptive language, not a separate general ledger feature.
WORKFLOW
A trade follows the deal
The record changes as orders are confirmed and the position is sold down.
textPreview: The record changes as orders are confirmed and the position is sold down.

text: 1  Open
Confirm a purchase order. The trade captures product, quantity, price and currency.
textPreview: Confirm a purchase order. The trade captures product, quantity, price and currency.

text: 2  Sell down
Confirm one or more sales. Sold quantity and the open position update.
textPreview: Confirm one or more sales. Sold quantity and the open position update.

text: 3  Close
When purchase and sale quantities fully match, the confirmed trade closes automatically.
textPreview: When purchase and sale quantities fully match, the confirmed trade closes automatically.

text: Short trades can start from a sale when no matching open trade exists.
textPreview: Short trades can start from a sale when no matching open trade exists.

text: Source: ele_trading README, section 4 and auto-close logic in section 6.

FINANCIAL DETAIL
Profit reflects the actual trade
The module keeps extra charges and currency conversion tied to their source dates.
textPreview: The module keeps extra charges and currency conversion tied to their source dates.

text: Transaction date FX
Each purchase or sale converts at its own transaction date into the reporting currency.
textPreview: Each purchase or sale converts at its own transaction date into the reporting currency.

text: Additional cost and revenue
Linked bills and invoices contribute amounts beyond the original order values.
textPreview: Linked bills and invoices contribute amounts beyond the original order values.

text: A market price can be entered on an open trade to estimate unrealized P&L.
textPreview: A market price can be entered on an open trade to estimate unrealized P&L.

text: Source: ele_trading README, sections 2, 4, 6 and 7. Mixed currency sale prices are converted to the reporting currency before blending.
OPERATIONAL DETAIL
Commercial and physical are different
The module tracks both, because they answer different questions.
textPreview: The module tracks both, because they answer different questions.

text: Open position
Purchase quantity less sold quantity. This is the outstanding commercial exposure.
